incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple GPU OOMs during prefill observed on cluster=infra-inference-hotpool-2. 42 restarts in 5m, crashlooping user-facing pods. Paging on-call.
oncall-ash: Ack, taking this. Pulling logs and metrics now.
sre-mike: Initial look: container restarts show 'CUDA out of memory' inside prefill path. Top offenders have context lengths > 65k tokens. KV cache allocations spike immediately before crash.
eng-anna: Reproduced locally with long-context fixture. Prefill alloc path = batch_size * seq_len * kv_size -> immediate spike. Sample trace: ```OOM: CUDA allocation failed at inference/runtime/prefill.cc:234\nBacktrace: 0x55a3... 0x55b4...\nModel: gptx-65k, seq=70000, batch=1```
infra-liz: Observability: 503s on /v1/chat correlated with the restarts. Alerting shows affected orgs: org_78A, org_22B, org_trial_5. CS notified.
cs-jordan: Confirmed customer reports: 3 accounts saw ~30s errors and 5xx spikes between 14:02-14:10 UTC. Sent interim update.
oncall-ash: Quick mitigation proposal: 1) throttle prefill tokens at router for long-route 2) scale hotpool temporarily 3) route very long contexts to cold-model fallback. Applying throttle now: setting max_prefill_tokens=65536 on route filters.
eng-anna: Hotpatch ready: update router config to split incoming long contexts into smaller prefill chunks and force seq_limit=4096 per batch. Deploying patch to edge-router-canary -> will push to prod in 60s if green.
sre-mike: Executing scale and tagging to reduce noisy neighbor placement: ```kubectl scale deployment/hotpool-2 --replicas=8 -n infra```
Also patching podAffinity to avoid packing large-prefill pods on same host.
eng-anna: If hotpool can't be stabilized, fallback plan: route >65k token requests to quantized coldpool (lower mem) and return 429+Retry-After for new long sessions. Implementing routing rule now.
incident-bot: Pager update: on-call handoff reminder to @oncall-ash in 30m.
oncall-ash: After throttle + scale: crash rate dropped from ~8/min to ~0.5/min within 4m. 503 rate on /v1/chat down 85%. Partial mitigation looks effective. :white_check_mark:
infra-liz: Added trace sampling for prompts causing large prefill; uploading top samples to s3://redwood-incidents/1888882000/samples.log and sharing link with eng.
cs-jordan: Customer comms: sent brief note to affected accounts, they reported service mostly recovered. Escalated to account leads for follow-up.
eng-anna: Post-mortem action items: enforce server-side per-org prefill token limits, add prompt_length metric and regression alert, improve batcher to avoid single-batch huge-seq allocations. Filing GH issues: RW-ops/infra#4321 RW-runtime#789.
product-raj: Assigning postmortem and customer impact summary. SLO hit likely, please include affected org list and minutes of degraded service.
oncall-ash: Handing off to night rotation in 45m. Notes: throttles applied, hotpool scaled 4->8, router patch id=router-canary-2026-09-14-abbc, samples uploaded to s3. If crash rate >1/hr escalate to SRE.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated (root cause: unbounded prefill allocations for very long contexts). Monitoring for 2h; escalate if crash_rate > 1/hr.
